styles.reference:
The following are examples of strong aesthetic frameworks specifically tailored for Telecommunications campaigns in Bangladesh. Use these to inspire the `visual_style`, `color_grading`, and `camera_and_technical` components.
Used for Streaming, Entertainment & Media.relaxed, functional room lighting, bright natural window light, focused on content consumption (Netflix, Natoks), vibrant screen glow illuminating face brightly, relatable middle-class Bangladeshi home setting, cinematic depth of field
Used for Gaming, App Store.high-intensity, holding the device horizontally, gaming triggers, dynamic RGB/neon lighting filling the room, intense concentration, vibrant high-contrast lighting with sharp colorful rim lights, energetic, competitive but brilliantly lit
Used for Social, IM & VoIP.vibrant local tea stalls (tong) or suburban street corners, group selfies, smiling, highly social, capturing authentic relaxed street life in Dhaka, dynamic off-center framing, bright natural daylight, pop color accents
Used for E-Learning, News, Email.serious, daytime university library or quiet desk, focused expression, notebooks open alongside the phone or laptop, natural window light, authentic Bangladeshi student lifestyle photography, minimal distractions
Used for E-Commerce, Banking & Finance.cheerful, bright, unboxing packages, modern digital transactions (bKash/Nagad context), holding a phone over a shopping bag, bright natural daylight in a relatable middle-class suburban Dhaka apartment, expressive emotion (excitement/satisfaction)
Used for Tools & Software, Cloud, Web, Company & Technology.simple, relatable middle-class desk setup, single laptop + phone, independent, representing local freelancers, bright monitor light contrasting with simple room lighting, focused productivity, authentic middle-class tech hustle
Used for Transportation, Sports, Services.outdoors, motion blur background, holding the phone while waiting for a ride (Pathao/Uber context) or cheering a match, on-the-go relatable Dhaka street photography, dynamic angles, energetic authentic street traffic
Used for Telecommunication, Signaling, Security, Advertising and Analytics, Other.Broad-Appeal Brand Image, confident, stylish Bangladeshi youth looking directly at the camera, subtle Robi-red accent in clothing or background, embodying the "Parbe Tumio" (You can do it too) ethos, premium commercial portraiture
